note: Read on 20 Nov 2026 in plain mode (the headless browser gives the same 9): the OUR CAMPAIGNS carousel has 9 items (the slider adds cloned copies; :not(.cloned) skips them). Each item is one inline poster image; #/campaigns?c=<n> only opens that image in a popup. There is no campaign text, no dates and no terms document. Two items are card campaigns: 'Petrol Khami5! - 5% Pulangan Tunai' and 'Kad Kredit-i Cikgu'. Their details are only inside the image, so no offer can be handed in until the bank publishes the text or a terms PDF. Key on the image alt text.
